supersession_reason: The response-blind predictor design, built before character masks, explicitly controls source host-resource breadth in addition to insect sampling geometry. No character mask, nucleotide identity, genetic distance, transfer statistic, or formal synthetic world had been opened under v0.1.
scientific_question: Do independently sampled Lepidoptera species with more similar native larval host-resource geography show more congruent post-IBD spatial genetic structure, beyond insect sampling geometry and simple host-resource breadth?

primary_predictor.name: native_host_resource_geography_jaccard
primary_predictor.definition: Jaccard similarity of frozen WCVP-v13 native, extant, non-doubtful WGSRPD3 host-resource footprints
primary_predictor.survivor_recomputation: After the character-mask gate, retain the same host footprints but recompute all pair pools, kernels, standardization and target-fixed-effect residuals on the exact survivor species set with inherited train/eval roles.

predictor_nuisance_control.reason_for_resource_breadth_terms: Jaccard overlap must not be interpreted as geography-specific evidence merely because broad host-resource footprints overlap many species.

pairwise_transfer_surface.alignment: nearest source edge midpoint for each target edge within 500 km
pairwise_transfer_surface.pair_transfer_congruence: Pearson correlation between aligned source and target endpoint-safe post-IBD edge responses

primary_statistic.per_target: Pearson correlation across supported sources between residualized host-resource Jaccard and pairwise transfer congruence
primary_statistic.panel: arithmetic mean of finite target correlations

geometry_confounded_trap.kernel: Gaussian RBF kernel of frozen insect geometry features

resource_breadth_trap.kernel: mean of Laplacian kernels on standardized log1p native host-species count and WGSRPD3 footprint-unit count

host_resource_positive.kernel: exact Jaccard/Tanimoto kernel of binary native WGSRPD3 host-resource presence

formal_inference.method: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope
formal_inference.p_value: maximum +1-corrected upper-tail p-value across the three nuisance reference cells

stopping_rules: No formal synthetic reference or evaluation statistic may be inspected before the exact character-mask survivor design is frozen.
The character-mask gate may remove species but may not resplit roles, alter host footprints, relax support rules, drop individual graph edges, or change marker.
If any exact-survivor formal gate fails, stop before nucleotide identity and report NOT_EVALUABLE.
Do not change nuisance covariates, Jaccard, alignment cap, synthetic kernels, amplitudes, seed tags, alpha or gates after formal worlds are inspected.
Any successor after a failed formal gate requires a new method version and fully disjoint seed namespaces.
